publications.title: Why You Must Run on the Latest Release Update
publications.description: Explains why unsupported Oracle Database releases and missing security, patch set, or release updates create greater operational risk than running a newer release not explicitly certified by an application vendor.

publications.title: From Transportable Tablespaces to Pluggable Databases
publications.description: Traces Oracle data portability from transportable tablespaces and full transportable export/import to unplug, clone, refresh, and relocate operations with pluggable databases.

publications.title: Improving Statspack Experience
publications.description: Improves Statspack installation, snapshot scheduling, purging, reporting, and RAC operation for systems where Oracle Diagnostic Pack is unavailable or unlicensed.

publications.title: Performance for All Editions on ODA X6-2S/M
publications.description: Explains how the ODA X6-2S and X6-2M make Oracle Standard Edition deployments practical, including licensing, standby design, capacity, and performance considerations.

publications.title: Is Your AWR/Statspack Report Relevant?
publications.description: Explains how report duration, captured SQL, database time, load profile, host statistics, and wait-event context determine whether an AWR or Statspack report supports a valid performance diagnosis.

publications.title: I/O Error on a Datafile: Instance Crash or Datafile Offline?
publications.description: Examines how Oracle handles datafile write failures across releases, RAC, and multitenant databases, including the availability trade-offs of crashing the instance or taking a datafile offline.

publications.title: Demystifying WORKLOAD System Statistics Gathering
publications.description: Explains how Oracle gathers workload system statistics, how direct-path and multiblock reads affect SREADTIM, MREADTIM, and MBRC, and why collected values must be checked before optimizer use.

publications.title: 12c Online Statistics Gathering & Session Private Statistics
publications.description: Explores Oracle 12c online statistics gathering, its limitations and side effects, and its interaction with session-private statistics on global temporary tables.
